lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were collected through crowdsourced mapping during Peru's CONIDA 2025 national mapping marathon, coordinated by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. Data was compiled from volunteer contributions to OpenStreetMap and exported as a GeoJSON file containing building geometries with standardized OSM tags for addresses, amenities, and facility information.
